author: Robbie Ferguson
changes: Built custom digital asset manager (DAM) for streamlined image loading.
Introduced sprite-based thumbnails with visual progress indicator.
Added SQLite caching for instant loading and opened-file tracking.
Enabled full network drive (UNC) path and metadata support.
Improved update checking logic to properly identify development builds.
Reduced binary bloat by optimizing asset directory structures.
Added geocoordinates to sample photos with improved OpenStreetMap links.
Updated sample exports to version v1.2.
Improved visual styling for active accordion headers.
Renamed accordion panels to reflect professional workflows.
Refined Clarity filter with a smooth parabolic curve for fine-tuning.
Added RGB histogram scope to the Color Grading panel.
Application now launches maximized by default.
